'''Samuel John Lomonaco Jr.'''  is an American academic and mathematician who is a professor of computer science and electrical engineering at the [[University of Maryland, Baltimore County]].

== Background ==
Lomonaco earned a Bachelor of Science degree in mathematics from [[Saint Louis University (United States)|Saint Louis University]] and a PhD in mathematics from [[Princeton University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Samuel Lomonaco|url=https://www.csee.umbc.edu/people/faculty/samuel-lomonaco/|access-date=2021-01-18|website=Department of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering|language=en-US}}</ref> Lomonaco specializes in [[quantum computation]], [[topology]], [[quantum information science]], [[knot theory]], and [[quantum algorithm]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Samuel Lomonaco|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=0PMb9xcAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=2021-01-18|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=dblp: Samuel J. Lomonaco|url=https://dblp.org/pid/64/5336.html|access-date=2021-01-18|website=dblp.org|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Professor Samuel J. Lomonaco : Home Page|url=https://www.csee.umbc.edu/~lomonaco/|access-date=2021-01-18|website=www.csee.umbc.edu}}</ref>
